# Model Context Protocol (MCP)

> AI モデルと外部ツール・データソースを標準化された方法で接続するオープンプロトコル MCP の仕様・ドキュメント・ブログを、開発者および実装者向けに提供する公式リポジトリ。

## Guide

- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/AGENTS.md): This repository contains the MCP specification, documentation, and blog.
- [Antitrust](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/ANTITRUST.md): This project is part of LF Projects, LLC.
- [{{ replace .File.ContentBaseName "-" " " | title }}](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/archetypes/default.md)
- [ Index](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/_index.md): +++ title = 'Model Context Protocol Blog' +++
- [Archives](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/archives.md)
- [MCP Prompts: Building Workflow Automation](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-07-29-prompts-for-automation.md): A practical guide to building workflow automation with MCP prompts and resource templates, demonstrated through a meal planning example.
- [Building to Last: A New Governance Model for MCP](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-07-31-governance-for-mcp.md): Introducing MCP's formal governance model: Specification Enhancement Proposals (SEPs), a maintainer structure, and a community-driven process for evolving the protocol.
- [Announcing the Official PHP SDK for MCP](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-09-05-php-sdk.md): The official PHP SDK for the Model Context Protocol is now generally available, built in collaboration with the PHP Foundation and Symfony.
- [Introducing the MCP Registry](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-09-08-mcp-registry-preview.md): Launching the MCP Registry in preview: an open catalog and API for discovering publicly available MCP servers.
- [Update on the Next MCP Protocol Release](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-09-26-mcp-next-version-update.md): An update on the timeline and priorities for the next Model Context Protocol specification version
- [Server Instructions: Giving LLMs a user manual for your server](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-11-03-using-server-instructions.md): How server instructions give LLMs the context they need to use your MCP server's tools effectively — an underused protocol feature with outsized impact.
- [Adopting the MCP Bundle format (.mcpb) for portable local servers](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-11-20-adopting-mcpb.md): The MCP Bundle format (.mcpb) joins the MCP project, enabling one-click installation of local servers across any compatible client.
- [MCP Apps: Extending servers with interactive user interfaces](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-11-21-mcp-apps.md): Introducing the MCP Apps Extension proposal (SEP-1865) to standardize interactive user interfaces in MCP, developed with the MCP-UI creators and maintainers from OpenAI and Anthropic.
- [One Year of MCP: November 2025 Spec Release](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-11-25-first-mcp-anniversary.md): MCP turns one — a look back at the year, plus the full details of the November 2025 specification release.
- [SEPs Are Moving to Pull Requests](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-11-28-sep-process-update.md): SEPs are moving from GitHub Issues to pull requests against the seps/ directory — why, and what changes for contributors.
- [MCP joins the Agentic AI Foundation](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-12-09-mcp-joins-agentic-ai-foundation.md): Anthropic is donating MCP to the newly formed Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation, ensuring vendor-neutral governance for the protocol's future.
- [Exploring the Future of MCP Transports](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2025-12-19-mcp-transport-future.md): The Transport Working Group's plan to evolve MCP beyond Streamable HTTP for enterprise-scale remote deployments.
- [January MCP Core Maintainer Update](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2026-01-22-core-maintainer-update.md): Core Maintainer team changes for 2026: departing members, new additions, and what's ahead for MCP governance.
- [MCP Apps - Bringing UI Capabilities To MCP Clients](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2026-01-26-mcp-apps.md): MCP Apps is now live as the first official MCP extension — tools can return interactive UI components that render directly in the conversation.
- [The 2026 MCP Roadmap](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2026-03-09-roadmap-update.md): The updated Model Context Protocol roadmap for 2026: transport scalability, agent communication, governance maturation, and enterprise readiness, plus guidance on SEP prioritization and how to get involved.
- [Understanding MCP Extensions](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2026-03-11-understanding-mcp-extensions.md): A practical guide to MCP extensions: how they layer new capabilities on top of the core protocol, and patterns the community is already using.
- [Tool Annotations as Risk Vocabulary: What Hints Can and Can't Do](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2026-03-16-tool-annotations.md): MCP tool annotations were introduced nearly a year ago as a way for servers to describe the behavior of their tools — whether they're read-only, destructive, idempotent, or reach outside their local environment.
- [Expanding the MCP Maintainer Team](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2026-04-08-maintainer-update.md): Updates to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance team: a new Lead Maintainer and an addition to the Core Maintainer group as the open-source project continues to grow.
- [The 2026-07-28 MCP Specification Release Candidate](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/blog/content/posts/2026-05-21-mcp-2026-07-28-rc.md): The release candidate for the next Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification is now available: a stateless protocol core, the Extensions framework, Tasks, MCP Apps, authorization hardening, and a formal deprecation policy.

- [What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/docs/getting-started/intro.md): MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external systems.
- [Architecture overview](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/docs/learn/architecture.md): This overview of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) discusses its scope and core concepts, and provides an example demonstrating each core concept.
- [Understanding MCP clients](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/docs/learn/client-concepts.md): MCP clients are instantiated by host applications to communicate with particular MCP servers.
- [Understanding MCP servers](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/docs/learn/server-concepts.md): MCP servers are programs that expose specific capabilities to AI applications through standardized protocol interfaces.
- [Versioning](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/docs/learn/versioning.md): The Model Context Protocol uses string-based version identifiers following the format YYYY-MM-DD, to indicate the last date backwards incompatible changes were made.
- [SDKs](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/docs/sdk.md): Official SDKs for building with Model Context Protocol
- [Debugging](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/docs/tools/debugging.md): A comprehensive guide to debugging Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations
- [MCP Inspector](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/docs/tools/inspector.md): In-depth guide to using the MCP Inspector for testing and debugging Model Context Protocol servers
- [Understanding Authorization in MCP](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/docs/tutorials/security/authorization.md): Learn how to implement secure authorization for MCP servers using OAuth 2.1 to protect sensitive resources and operations
- [Security Best Practices](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/docs/tutorials/security/security_best_practices.md): Security considerations, attack vectors, and best practices for MCP implementations
- [Example Servers](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/examples.md): A list of example servers and implementations
- [Build an MCP App](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/extensions/apps/build.md): Getting started guide for building interactive UI applications with MCP Apps
- [MCP Apps](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/extensions/apps/overview.md): Interactive UI applications that render inside MCP hosts like Claude Desktop
- [Enterprise-Managed Authorization](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/extensions/auth/enterprise-managed-authorization.md): Centralized access control for MCP in enterprise environments via identity providers
- [OAuth Client Credentials](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/extensions/auth/oauth-client-credentials.md): Machine-to-machine authentication for MCP using the OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow
- [Authorization Extensions](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/extensions/auth/overview.md): Supplementary authorization mechanisms for the Model Context Protocol
- [Extension Support Matrix](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/extensions/client-matrix.md): Which MCP clients implement which official extensions
- [Extensions Overview](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/extensions/overview.md): Optional extensions to the Model Context Protocol
- [MCP Tasks](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/extensions/tasks/overview.md): Asynchronous task execution for long-running MCP operations
- [The MCP Registry](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/registry/about.md): The MCP Registry is the official centralized metadata repository for publicly accessible MCP servers, backed by major trusted contributors to the MCP ecosystem such as Anthropic, GitHub, PulseMCP, and Microsoft.
- [How to Authenticate When Publishing to the Official MCP Registry](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/registry/authentication.md): You must authenticate before publishing to the official MCP Registry.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/registry/faq.md): - "MCP Registry API" — An API that implements the OpenAPI spec defined by the MCP Registry.
- [How to Automate Publishing with GitHub Actions](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/registry/github-actions.md): In your server project directory, create a .github/workflows/publish-mcp.yml file.

- [Specification Enhancement Proposals (SEPs)](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/seps/index.md): Index of all MCP Specification Enhancement Proposals
- [Snippet Intro](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/snippets/snippet-intro.md): One of the core principles of software development is DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself).
- [Architecture](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/architecture/index.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) follows a client-host-server architecture where each host can run multiple client instances.
- [Overview](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/basic/index.md): All messages between MCP clients and servers MUST follow the JSON-RPC 2.0 specification.
- [Lifecycle](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/basic/lifecycle.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) defines a rigorous lifecycle for client-server connections that ensures proper capability negotiation and state management.
- [Messages](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/basic/messages.md): All messages in MCP MUST follow the JSON-RPC 2.0 specification.
- [Transports](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/basic/transports.md): MCP currently defines two standard transport mechanisms for client-server communication:
- [Cancellation](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/basic/utilities/cancellation.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) supports optional cancellation of in-progress requests through notification messages.
- [Ping](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/basic/utilities/ping.md): The Model Context Protocol includes an optional ping mechanism that allows either party to verify that their counterpart is still responsive and the connection is alive.
- [Progress](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/basic/utilities/progress.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) supports optional progress tracking for long-running operations through notification messages.
- [Roots](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/client/roots.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a standardized way for clients to expose filesystem "roots" to servers.
- [Sampling](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/client/sampling.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a standardized way for servers to request LLM sampling ("completions" or "generations") from language models via clients.
- [Specification](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/index.md): Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol that enables seamless integration between LLM applications and external data sources and tools.
- [Overview](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/server/index.md): Servers provide the fundamental building blocks for adding context to language models via MCP.
- [Prompts](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/server/prompts.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a standardized way for servers to expose prompt templates to clients.
- [Resources](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/server/resources.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a standardized way for servers to expose resources to clients.
- [Tools](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/server/tools.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) allows servers to expose tools that can be invoked by language models.
- [Completion](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/server/utilities/completion.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a standardized way for servers to offer argument autocompletion suggestions for prompts and resource URIs.
- [Logging](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/server/utilities/logging.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a standardized way for servers to send structured log messages to clients.
- [Pagination](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2024-11-05/server/utilities/pagination.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) supports paginating list operations that may return large result sets.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2025-03-26/architecture/index.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) follows a client-host-server architecture where each host can run multiple client instances.
- [Authorization](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2025-03-26/basic/authorization.md): The Model Context Protocol provides authorization capabilities at the transport level, enabling MCP clients to make requests to restricted MCP servers on behalf of resource owners.
- [Overview](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2025-03-26/basic/index.md): The Model Context Protocol consists of several key components that work together:
- [Lifecycle](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2025-03-26/basic/lifecycle.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) defines a rigorous lifecycle for client-server connections that ensures proper capability negotiation and state management.
- [Transports](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2025-03-26/basic/transports.md): MCP uses JSON-RPC to encode messages.
- [Cancellation](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2025-03-26/basic/utilities/cancellation.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) supports optional cancellation of in-progress requests through notification messages.
- [Ping](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2025-03-26/basic/utilities/ping.md): The Model Context Protocol includes an optional ping mechanism that allows either party to verify that their counterpart is still responsive and the connection is alive.
- [Progress](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2025-03-26/basic/utilities/progress.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) supports optional progress tracking for long-running operations through notification messages.
- [Key Changes](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2025-03-26/changelog.md): This document lists changes made to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification since the previous revision, 2024-11-05.
- [Roots](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/specification/2025-03-26/client/roots.md): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) provides a standardized way for clients to expose filesystem "roots" to servers.
